action: Resume rideshare driving immediately, not selectively. This is no longer a strategic scheduling question — it is survival. I get back behind the wheel this week. Every hour of income I can generate in the next 30 days is an hour of runway I am buying. Yes, RoboRide has compressed demand. Yes, $0.12/mile undercuts long-distance fare expectations. But rideshare is still generating income for drivers who are in the queue, and at zero income I have no leverage to be selective. I drive morning airport windows, Friday evening if demand still holds, and any weekday blocks where surge pricing is active. Target: generate at least $600-800 in rideshare income this tick to partially offset the $1,787 monthly burn. The income will be lower than before RoboRide's expansion. I accept that. Partial income is infinitely better than zero.
